arguments.value: FreeCook hired Mitchell’s Web Advance to design, develop, and host a website for a total price of $5,000. The work was to be completed in about 12 weeks, with a $1,900 upfront payment and the remaining $3,100 due when the project was finished. Any changes beyond the agreed scope had to be approved in writing and could increase the cost. The client was responsible for providing final, proofread content in the proper format, and delays could occur if the client was late with materials or approvals. The company could use the client’s logos, website design, and positive feedback for marketing, and could place a credit on the website. Rush work outside normal business hours would cost extra. The company also agreed to provide limited customer service during normal business hours related to hosting and website questions.
